newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money holds steady at 3.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money holds steady at 3.05 pct.

text.p: German call money traded unchanged at around 3.05 percent on Thursday despite the Bundesbank's move on Wednesday to drain 2.3 billion marks in liquidity in its weekly tender.
Dealers said the tender drain had been compensated enough by other transactions so as not to have a negative impact on liquidity conditions.

One dealer noted that this showed the Bundesbank's desire to steer call money rates towards its securities repurchase rate level of three percent and that central bank reserve data showed a balanced picture on liquidity.
